race.comment: KICKER MINI (1) recorded a 4.5 lengths win in a Grade 5 last time 17.62 at this track and trip and also jumping from the same draw. Has the ability and looks hard to top. BLAZING BISCUIT (3) produced a moderate performance last time when eighth at Gosford over 388m behind Sue's Memory (23.13) in a Grade 5. Form from her last run is proving strong. Key runner on best form. GUNNELL GIRL (2) has a moderate overall strike-rate. Finished in the minors latest when second (17.74) at this track and may be close to breaking through. Solid record at the distance winning five races. Form from her last run is proving to be solid. Bold showing expected. FLYING SAUCER (8) deserves plenty of thought over this trip.
